title: How Do You Find a Lost Colony? Look for a Blacksmith #shorts
description:
Researchers on Hatteras Island say they found hammerscale, iron flakes from blacksmithing, in soil dated to the Lost Colony's time. It's been announced, not yet published in a peer-reviewed paper.

Full investigation on the channel: What Happened to the Lost Colony of Roanoke? I'm 60% Sure Some Survived

Sources: Horton & Dawson, Hatteras excavations (2025 announcement, reported by Live Science and WHRO). Images: de Bry after John White (1590), public domain.

Narration and visuals are AI-generated.
